The act of threatening to use force to get money is extortion (敲诈勒索). Also assault (故意伤害) for beating. So crimes: 诈骗; 敲诈勒索; 故意伤害; 可能非法拘禁? They held her in house? They threatened and kept her? They prevented her from leaving? They detained her? Could be illegal detention (非法拘禁). The facts: they threatened and watched, but not necessarily detained. They forced her to sign contract, but she could leave? Not clear. Probably illegal detention.

Thus final answer: [罪名]诈骗;敲诈勒索;故意伤害;非法拘禁<eoa>
